findings.title: VBST net of the buck converter lacks the required diode from the output to the bootstrap capacitor
findings.why: Without the diode the bootstrap capacitor cannot charge, preventing the high‑side MOSFET from turning on
findings.fix: Add a Schottky diode from the +5 V output to the VBST net

findings.title: NRST pin is left floating with no pull‑up resistor
findings.why: The MCU reset line may randomly trigger or stay low at power‑up, leading to unpredictable behavior
findings.fix: Add a pull‑up resistor (e.g., 10 kΩ) from NRST to +3.3 V

findings.title: Servo header J4 pin order is signal, ground, power instead of signal, power, ground
findings.why: The connected servo will receive reversed power and ground pins, causing it not to operate or be damaged
findings.fix: Rewire J4 so pin2 is +5V and pin3 is GND

findings.title: Track width on +3.3V net is only 0.30 mm while at least 1.5 mm is required for the 3 A buck output
findings.why: Insufficient copper width can cause excessive heating and voltage drop on the high‑current rail
findings.fix: Widen the +3.3V traces to ≥1.5 mm or add a copper pour on both layers to carry the current

findings.title: Track width on +5V net is only 0.50 mm but must be ≥1.0 mm for the combined ~2 A servo load
findings.why: The narrow trace may overheat and cause voltage sag to the servos
findings.fix: Increase the +5V trace width to at least 1.0 mm or provide a copper pour on both layers

findings.title: Narrowest track on GND net is 0.30 mm while the net carries >3 A from buck, servos and stepper driver
findings.why: Undersized ground traces increase resistance and can lead to voltage reference errors and heating
findings.fix: Enlarge the minimum GND trace width to ≥1.5 mm or rely on the existing copper pours with wider connecting traces

findings.title: Decoupling capacitor C2 is 7.4 mm away from U1 VO pin
findings.why: Excessive distance increases loop inductance, reducing decoupling effectiveness
findings.fix: Place C2 within 5 mm of the U1 VO pin

findings.title: Decoupling capacitor C16 is 17.2 mm away from U3 GND pin
findings.why: Very long loop path reduces high‑frequency decoupling for the ULN2003 driver
findings.fix: Relocate C16 to be within 5 mm of the U3 GND pin

findings.title: Decoupling capacitor C3 is 6.8 mm away from S1 GND pin
findings.why: Distance may cause insufficient high‑frequency bypass for the buck converter
findings.fix: Place C3 closer (≤5 mm) to the S1 GND pin

findings.title: Resistor R4 has no defined resistance value

findings.title: +3.3VA net has no power source

findings.title: Feedback resistor divider (R2 = 56.2 kΩ, R3 = 10 kΩ) sets a feedback voltage that yields ~3.3 V output instead of the intended 5 V
findings.why: The buck converter will regulate to the wrong voltage, causing downstream circuits to receive insufficient power
findings.fix: Resize the divider to match the converter’s reference (e.g., R2≈40 kΩ, R3≈10 kΩ for a 5 V output with a 0.5 V reference)
